h1.en: Resulting force due to Mass flow and Flow Velocity is the heading; LZ 80 Diesel Concrete Pump stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「合力 由于 到 质量流量与流速」，主体仍是柴油大排量：在邢台对照 LZ-80 和柴油120

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for LZ 80 Diesel Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump. LZ-60 prints 50 m³/h. 100 m³/h is Diesel 120. Its own output cell is 50 m³/h. Weight is 6800 kg versus 8000 kg. Low pressure on LZ-80 is ≤ 95 m³/h. Both LZ-80 and Diesel 120 print 0.6 m³. LZ-80 and Diesel 120 both print 6 cm and below. LZ-80’s outputs and pressures are printed with ≤. The high-output diesel note includes it beside LZ-80 and Diesel 120. The engines do not match: one Yuchai 256 kW versus two 145 kW units. An order that changes ≤ 95 into 95 as a guaranteed rate rewrites the cell. Write the mode for LZ-80 or the twin-engine line for Diesel 120, plus aggregate. Diesel 120 prints 290 kW from two 145 kW engines, 100 m³/h, 40 MPa, 150 m / 500 m and hopper 0.6 m³. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai’s high-output diesel note says to compare LZ-80 and Diesel 120, and it also names LZ-60. LZ-80 prints Yuchai 256 kW, high pressure ≤ 65 m³/h at ≤ 35 MPa, low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h at ≤ 22 MPa, hopper 0.6 m³, conveying 120 m, and delivery height “consult factory standard”. The section title “Online Pipe Bend Resulting Force Calculator” comes from the source page and does not add a rating.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是柴油大排量：在邢台对照 LZ-80 和柴油120的数字。要打开的行是 /products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump。100 m³/h 是柴油120。LZ-60 印 50 m³/h。它自己的输送量格是 50 m³/h。LZ-80 的输送量和压力都带 ≤。LZ-80 低压是 ≤ 95 m³/h。重量是 6800 kg 对 8000 kg。LZ-80 和柴油120都印 0.6 m³。LZ-80 和柴油120都印 6 cm 及以下。把 ≤ 95 改成保证 95 的订单，是在改写格子。柴油大排量说明把它和 LZ-80、柴油120放在一起。发动机不同：一台玉柴 256 kW，对两台 145 kW。写上 LZ-80 的模式，或柴油120的双机一行，以及骨料。河北品锦机械（邢台）的柴油大排量说明要求对照 LZ-80 和柴油120，并点了 LZ-60。柴油120印两台 145 kW 合计 290 kW、100 m³/h、40 MPa、150 m / 500 m、料斗 0.6 m³。LZ-80 印玉柴 256 kW，高压 ≤ 65 m³/h、≤ 35 MPa，低压 ≤ 95 m³/h、≤ 22 MPa，料斗 0.6 m³，输送距离 120 m，输送高度为“咨询工厂标准”。节标题「在线 管道 弯管 合力 计算器」来自来源页，不另加额定值。
